notes.title: Mending the Past. Umm, we mean a patch update for Hello Goodboy 😊
notes.notes:
Hello goodkid, have you enjoyed your journey with Coco in Kuruto?

First of all, we want to thank you for playing, streaming, giving love, and giving feedback to Hello Goodboy 🙂 It’s all precious to us and we are delighted. Thank you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/7ce256cc7b984cbbd936b026182513d813520dd3.gif

Also from all of that, we’re deploying a small update for Hello Goodboy. Mostly it's a micro bug in the graphical aspect. But we also updating a few dialogues for Hachi and Hedera in the Spring Door.

This dialogue revision will not change the story, so no need to worry much about it. We just make a few dialogues to be more generic and can be accepted by more people. If you have played the Spring Door before, can you find the changes on this patch? Tell us your finding and opinion below 😀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/2385af3252782ba59fa61097f1b6f24b0edd6bce.gif

By the way, we want to thank you too for giving review and feedback on the Hello Goodboy Steam Store page. If you haven’t, feel free to write your experience of playing Hello Goodboy there too! We love to read your review and story of your journey in Kuruto!

Feel free to share your journey in Hello Goodboy too on your social media! You can find us on Twitter, Discord, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok!

Have a good day from Hello Goodboy!

notes.title: Hello Goodboy February 2023 Developer Update
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest - thank you for your participation
Hello Goodboy joined this Steam Next Fest on February 6th-13rd. We want to say thank you to everyone who participated in this event. Thank you for playing the demo, streaming the demo, resharing our post on social media, or giving feedback. We hope you like the game and are eager to play the full version.

New Trailer and Reveal OST
At Steam Next Fest, we also released a new gameplay trailer along with Hello Goodboy OST, With Me. We also showed the behind the scenes video for recording this beautiful music. Be sure to follow our Twitter for more! 

[previewyoutube=fGRUe5AWQNI;full][/previewyoutube]

Polishing and Adjustment on Art, Audio, and Narrative 
All your responses and feedbacks are very much appreciated, and we always polish and adjust Hello Goodboy to become better and ever.


 We also adjusted the text size and accessibility for the Gratitude Journal.
 Some narrative was adjusted to have smoother dialogue and story plot.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/fcac9d784ec9d0fe1cb3b44b42dc8d8ea902fe24.png

notes.title: Spring and other Seasons! November Update
notes.notes:
Hello good friends! 

We’re here with a development update!

We have finished “Spring” Story Arc! Here’s a sneak peek:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/f641af29fa75def9d2b88c79baf4869ee0a2731a.gif

This means all of the season arcs are in the game - Summer, Fall, Winter, and Spring!

Much like other season arcs, Spring has its own unique in-game elements: puzzles, food, and story just to name a few. One of them is repairing the picnic bench. Can you imagine having a picnic in Spring?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/416edd260c7fb4ec58ea46a2e5778cf7e20b9b83.gif

The special iconic food in this Spring Arc is Martabak or Terang Bulan. Some people call it Martabak, but others call it Terang Bulan. Let us know in the comments what you’d call it! 

While everyone debates on what to call this food, our team contemplated how to grab it 😄
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/1e908a19f1a4d32e0922e57c56ef0127ce9c42af.png

In the meantime, our team is revisiting, polishing, and adjusting elements that already exist in the game so you, as players, will have the best experience. Some of the adjustments we’ve made are Iko and Coco’s expressions in game. By making them more expressive, we hope you will have a more immersive experience!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447212/2f8daacabb27fae5ab4c7a3f63720ee8b1032a20.png

We’ve begun localization and Steam Deck support as well. We’re super excited to bring Hello Goodboy to other languages and platforms!

For further updates, please join our Discord, follow us on Twitter, and catch up with us on our other social medias. We’d love to hear from you!

Until next time. Be good! 🐾
